# Field Shift · Rotation Explorer

> Farmer-facing crop rotation explorer using NASA POWER weather for a real field pin. NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, challenge Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data.

Field Shift does not replace agronomists, soil tests, or on-farm observation. Scores are rule-based (water, soil, farmer priorities), not a black-box model. NASA does not endorse the recommendations.

## Pages

- [Explorer](https://github.com/0xUkobong/fieldshift): Pin continent → country → state → local government → area, then compare rotations.
- [About](/About): Who it is for and how to use it.
- [Disclaimer](/Disclaimer): Decision support, no warranty, no NASA endorsement of scores.
- [Privacy](/Privacy): Records stay on the device; POWER and Nominatim receive coordinates or search text.
- [Data sources](/Data_sources): NASA POWER, OpenStreetMap Nominatim, ISO 3166 via pycountry.

## Facts

- Climate API: NASA POWER daily point, agriculture community.
- Parameters: T2M, T2M_MAX, T2M_MIN, PRECTOTCORR, ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN, RH2M.
- Audience: smallholders, farm families, extension workers worldwide.
- Languages for share cards: English, French, Kiswahili, Hausa.
- Storage: local SQLite `data/fieldshift.db`, no cloud account.
